Object.name: GeneXusAI
Object.description: GeneXus Artificial Intelligence module

Object.moduleDescription: GeneXusAI module contains a common set of Artificial Intelligence tasks, including audio, text, image and video processing, all of them provided by several cloud-based platforms (e.g. IBM Watson, Microsoft Azure Cognitive Services, SAP Leonardo).
